# Figarland Family

![](../../assets/mods/hakirework.png){ .entry-page-icon }

[All bloodlines](index.md)

This line gives you another chance to be born with Conqueror’s Haki. Sword hits are stronger with a sword in your main hand, and your Conqueror’s Haki grows faster once awakened.

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

| Stat | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Haki Realm birth roll | 1% |
| Known carriers | Shanks, Garling and Shamrock |
| Extra birth roll for Conqueror’s Haki | 15% if the regular roll misses |
| Conqueror’s Haki XP | 1.25× |
| Sword damage bonus | +5% |

</div>
